verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a product analytics platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only describes Mixpanel as a hosted service: a hosted MCP server, EU Data Residency in Mixpanel's own infrastructure, warehouse sync into Mixpanel, and export APIs. Data residency and export are adjacent controls, not a self-hostable deployment, and a community report of building an in-house replacement is a user-side workaround, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
